integrity: The proof combines the published mixed-volume/random-determinant representation for zonoids with an explicit six-vector determinant identity, exact spherical one-dimensional integrals, and affine covariance. The bundled checker exhausts all standard-basis tuples for the multilinear determinant identity and checks the rational normalization factors; it is not used as a substitute for the analytic spherical-expectation proof.
limitations: The result is an exact ellipsoid benchmark for the three-dimensional Janson coefficient. It does not characterize equality in Janson’s inequality and does not give a universal bound for centrally symmetric bodies or zonoids.
title: Exact three-dimensional ellipsoid benchmark for Janson’s higher-order Godbersen coefficient
